connector.name: Last.fm
connector.registryDescription: Last.fm MCP server: scrobbles, charts, artist/album/track info and more
connector.summary: Runs locally from the container image lastfm-mcp:0.1.0. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the ndyakov account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: LASTFM_API_SECRET
env.description: Last.fm API secret; only needed for authenticated/write methods

env.name: LASTFM_ENABLE_WRITES
env.description: Set to 1 to enable scrobbling/write tools
